title: Chú thích đầy đủ, dễ hiểu từng khối code Python cho cả 46 bài
owner_request: Sau khi xuất PDF 920 câu, chú thích đầy đủ code mọi bài. Giải thích cả Agg, plt.gca(), lines[0], get_xdata(), plt.close() và các API/đối số khó hiểu ngay trong code. Không thay đổi kết quả.

scope.work_style: Up to 5 sequential lessons per batch; one commit per lesson, test, PR, final-head GitHub CI SUCCESS, merge, ledger, next batch.
scope.target_code: All executable fenced Python blocks in every lesson, small concept examples as well as 5 progressive scenarios.
scope.immutable_material: Non-comment Python statements/AST, import/call order, datasets, stdout, figures, lesson prose/definitions, 20 MCQs per chapter.

rules: Always read AGENTS.md, docs/CURRICULUM-STYLE-GUIDE.md (new owner code-annotation directive), templates/lesson.md and authoritative repository files first.

Every executable Python code fence must have an accurate # Mục đích: note, and direct nearby Vietnamese comments for every non-obvious API, method, attribute, argument, algorithmic step, data meaning and result interpretation.

Explain WHAT/WHY and effect: matplotlib.use('Agg') selects headless renderer before pyplot; plt.gca() gets current Axes; .lines[0] accesses first plotted line; .get_xdata() reads line x coordinates; len() counts samples; plt.close() closes figure.

Audit non-trivial flags and parameter choices (axis, ddof, dtype, rowvar, seed/random_state, n_init, bins, .T, mask/index/slice, fit/transform, stratify, imputer, PCA, imports, I/O and resource cleanup).

Only add/change code comments beginning with #. Do not edit executable Python source, data, stdout or any content outside Python fences. Compare each corresponding code block with Python AST dump excluding positional attributes; check same code fence count.
Preserve all 46 lessons and 920 MCQ questions/options/answers/explanations exactly. Preserve 5 progressive scenarios with 10/12/15/18/20 records, markdown, images and references.
Avoid noisy comments that merely restate obvious assignments; be thorough where a new reader would otherwise not know what a function, chain, flag or operation is or why it was used.

Commit each lesson separately. Run full 46-chapter tests and per-example code execution/exact stdout, verify code AST equivalence, then merge only if final-head GitHub CI SUCCESS. Write batch SHA/CI/PR to durable ledger.
Do not silently rebind identity-unverified CDP port 9224, claim Windows PASS when PowerShell canary is unavailable, replay historical Jetking tasks or duplicate idle heartbeats.
If correct explanation requires changing actual executable code, document separately for owner approval; never sneak behavior changes into a comments-only goal.
When final batch merges and ledger is 10/10, mark goal COMPLETED and disable goal_review; no automatic new goal without owner approval.

example.original:
# Mục đích: Nối các mốc có thứ tự.
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [10, 15, 12])
print(len(plt.gca().lines[0].get_xdata()))
plt.close()
example.expected_notes: Mục đích thực tế, Agg backend không GUI, Axes của gca, lines[0] đường đầu, get_xdata trả tọa độ x, len đếm 3, close giải phóng; code AST/stdout giữ nguyên.

each_batch: All 46 chapter curriculum regressions and scenario script stdout
Ledger records PR, merged SHA and run ID
